channel.title: Florida Man Times
channel.description: The wildest true stories from the Sunshine State

item.title: Florida Man Shows Up to Polk County Booking With a Corkscrew Inside His Colon
item.description: He told deputies it had been in there for a year. A laxative did not change its mind.

item.title: Florida Teen Allegedly Revs a Chainsaw at His Mom After She Takes Away His Xbox
item.description: Deputies say she filmed it. When she said she'd call the law, he said they wouldn't get there in time.

item.title: Florida Man Allegedly Bags $776 of Candy in Two Trips. Judge Sets Bail at $100,000
item.description: Police say the Circle K manager spotted him the next day at a Wawa. He has 51 prior convictions.

item.title: Colorado Man Allegedly Traps Waymo Robotaxis With Traffic Cones, Then Eggs Them
item.description: Waymo's investigator counted 30 incidents in Denver. Prosecutors say it's a civil matter, for now.

item.title: Ohio Man Allegedly Takes a Power Saw to 3 of His Town's 8 License Plate Cameras
item.description: Police in Louisville, Ohio, say the cameras came down on two different nights. Now he faces 9 felony counts.

item.title: Florida Man Allegedly Runs From a Bartow Traffic Stop, Takes a Taser Below the Belt, Keeps Running
item.description: Deputies say the 21-year-old felon had also posted a photo of himself with a gun online. Sheriff Grady Judd had thoughts.

item.title: Florida Man Gets Nearly 4 Years for Using an AI Clone of a Famous Streamer's Voice to Score $260,000 in Crypto
item.description: He signed deals in Kick star N3on's name and sent a fake voice memo as proof. The meme coin crew paid up.

item.title: Florida Man Allegedly Poaches an 8-Point Buck, Then Posts the Video Online
item.description: FWC says the Plant City content creator reported the deer as a public-land harvest. His own footage had other ideas.

item.title: Florida Woman Loses Her License Over a Miami-Dade Camera Ticket for a Nebraska Plate That Expired in 2003
item.description: She hadn't been to Miami-Dade in nearly 20 years and has never been to Nebraska. The camera didn't care.

item.title: Tennessee Man Allegedly Takes a Stolen Street Sweeper for a 90 MPH Thanksgiving Spin
item.description: Nothing says holiday spirit like a curb-cleaning truck doing double the speed limit at 12:30 a.m.

item.title: Florida Man Allegedly Drives Off in a $150,000 G-Wagon After Telling the Valet It Was His
item.description: No ticket, no problem: police say a downtown Tampa valet stand handed over the keys, and GPS did the rest.

item.title: West Virginia Grandpa and Grandson Go Fishing. They Find an Alligator. In November.
item.description: A 38-inch gator turned up in a chilly creek off the New River, and Florida would like to know who gave out its address.

item.title: Bradenton Police Try to Herd a Flock of Runaway Sheep. The Sheep Win.
item.description: Officers showed up, bodycams rolling, and asked the question every Florida cop secretly fears: are sheep aggressive?

item.title: Florida Man Finds an 8-Foot Gator Stuck in the Jetty Rocks. So He Sat on It.
item.description: A bait-shop road trip in Fort Pierce turned into an alligator rescue, a catch pole failure and one very warm seat.

item.title: Roaches' Choice: Where Florida's Bugs Ate This Week (and Where You Should Instead)
item.description: 17 restaurants got shut down by the state this week. Over a thousand others aced it. Here's the scoreboard.

item.title: Lakewood Ranch Visitors Kept Feeding the Gators. Now Four of Them Are Gone.
item.description: A viral video of a gator leaping at a bridge full of snack-holding humans ended the way these things always end: badly for the gator.

item.title: Florida Grandma Allegedly Steals a $15 Inflatable Ghost Because the Grandkids Wanted It
item.description: Polk County deputies say the decoration tour came with a bonus stop. The bonus stop came with four charges.

item.title: Florida Woman Wears 'Retired Drug Dealer' Shirt. Deputies Say the Retirement Didn't Take.
item.description: A traffic stop in Citrus County turned up a backpack, a scale, 150 tiny baggies and a ledger. The shirt was not helping.

item.title: Florida Man Allegedly Hoses Down His Neighbor Over Dog Poop on His Lawn
item.description: Four dogs, one lawn, one high-pressure nozzle and a phone that will never turn on again.

item.title: Florida Man's Alleged Mailbox Rampage Ends at a Hotel, With a City Trash Bin Still Stuck Under the SUV
item.description: Cape Coral police didn't need a detective. They needed to follow the bumper.

item.title: Lawn Mowers, Golf Carts and a Horse: Florida's Weirdest Ways to Get a DUI
item.description: In the Sunshine State, the vehicle is optional. The arrest is not.

item.title: Florida Man Steals a School Bus, Drives It All Day Because He Figured He Could
item.description: No kids. No route. No plan. Just a big yellow dream and the open roads of Miami-Dade.

item.title: Florida Man Allegedly Pulls a Sword on His Roommate. The Issue? Sugar.
item.description: Lee County deputies say a coffee-sweetener dispute in North Fort Myers went from 'hey, that's mine' to medieval.

item.title: Welcome to Florida: New Arrivals Find an 8-Foot Gator Parked in Their Driveway
item.description: The couple just moved to Manatee County. The gator was here first, and he'd like you to know it.

item.title: Florida Woman Calls 911 Three Times Because a Bar Won't Serve Her a Jell-O Shot
item.description: Fire, flood, Jell-O shot denial. Only one of those is not an emergency, Marion County deputies would like you to know.

item.title: Florida Woman Allegedly Rings Up Her Target Haul at Loofah Prices
item.description: Bedding, bath products and groceries, all priced like a $2.99 bath sponge. Target staff were not fooled.

item.title: Florida Man's Getaway Ends in a Porta-Potty, Minus His Pants, Police Say
item.description: A beach stroll, a stolen SUV, a smashed gate and the worst hiding spot on Sanibel Island.
